caption: The drawing features a cylindrical, stoneware container with a wide, open top. The body of the container is a light gray color with a slightly darker rim around the opening. Three irregular horizontal brushstrokes in a vibrant blue color encircle the cylinder at different heights—one near the top, one in the middle, and one near the bottom. The brushstrokes vary in thickness and intensity. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color, and there are no other objects or markings present. The container is centrally placed on the page, with its base resting on an implied flat surface.
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
